notes:
Account snapshot: Sapphire Anchor is a global maritime logistics operator planning to consolidate inference for ETA predictions, document reranking, and a ship-ops chat assistant into a single Dedicated deployment. Heavy bursty telemetry (AIS + event streams) feeds inference for real-time recommendations.

Commercial ask: sustained throughput guarantees, burst capacity for peak windows, contractual latency SLOs, and reserved GPU planning with clearly defined SLA penalties. Finance comfortable with enterprise ARR if SLO + residency terms agreed.

Security: strong requirement for VPC private control plane, EU data residency for EU business units, KMS/HSM for keys, SOC2+ISO27001 evidence needed.

From discovery/demo calls: "We cannot have >5s tail latency on rerank updates during port arrival windows" — ops lead.  

AE notes (Avery): prefer Redwood Dedicated with Private control plane for segmentation. Interested in Optimize for batching suggestions to reduce cost. SE Diego to run sizing workshop; CSM Lena to prepare onboarding checklist once pilot success criteria met.
timeline: 2026-01-20: Intro call (AE + SE) — high-level use-case + cost sensitivity
2026-02-02: Technical deep-dive — sample logs shared (10M records), initial QPS estimate recorded
2026-02-10: Security questionnaire submitted (Sapphire -> Redwood) — SOC2 evidence requested
2026-03-02: Commercial terms draft received; follow-up call with procurement 2026-03-09
2026-03-05: Network test (whitelist) — minor packet loss flagged, ticket opened INF-7890
workload_profile: Steady-state baseline: 35 QPS, avg 450 tokens/response (~15.8k tokens/sec). Peak bursts: up to 200 QPS for short windows (90k tokens/sec). Typical sessions: 3-5 turn chats plus rerank ops. Embedding refresh jobs overnight (batch) — heavy token counts but lower latency requirement.
sla_requirements: Target SLA: 99.95% uptime; latency SLOs: p95 <= 250ms for 0-512 token responses, p99 negotiated for burst windows. Request explicit burst capacity guarantees (100k tokens/sec for up to 10 minutes, 30k sustained). Penalty language requested for repeated SLO breaches.
sizing_summary: Preliminary sizing workshop output (SE estimate): Equivalent of 12x A100-80GB (or 8x H100 equiv) reserved for steady 30k tokens/sec sustained with auto-burst pool of 4 extra GPUs for spikes. Suggestation: can reduce reserved count by 20% with aggressive caching + batching (Optimize), but requires model-variant routing and prefix caching. Plan: run 72h pilot on 8x A100 reserved + burst pool to validate throughput and p95 latency before final commit.
poc_milestones: Pilot metrics: p95 latency < 300ms, sustain 30k tokens/sec, handle 100k tokens/sec bursts without >5s tail latency
Week 1: baseline load, collect token/sec distribution; Week 2: enable batching + prefix caching; Week 3: run end-to-end failure and fallback tests; Week 4: prepare handoff docs and cost/ops runbook
